policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Acute, sudden onset headache (< 4 weeks), with any ONE of the following: ○ A personal or family history (brother, sister, parent, or child) of brain aneurysm or AVM (arteriovenous malformation) ○ < 48 hours of “worst headache in my life” or “thunderclap” headache (Sudden onset new headache reaching maximum intensity within 2-3 minutes, lasting more than 5 minutes) ○ Prior history of stroke or intracranial bleed ○ Known coagulopathy or on anticoagulation

criteria.description: Acute sudden onset headache with duration less than 4 weeks
At least one high-risk vascular or intracranial red flag feature present
Personal or first-degree family history of brain aneurysm or AVM
Thunderclap onset or worst headache of life within 48 hours
Prior history of stroke or intracranial bleed
Known coagulopathy or currently on active anticoagulation therapy

required_documentation: Neurology or ED consultation notes detailing headache onset and duration
Medication list or family history notes documenting specific high risk feature
review_notes: Emergency and acute high-risk headache indication for Brain MRI.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: Additional Indications in the Pediatric Population (<18) When None of the Above Apply
source_quote: Persistent headache and any ONE of the following (8–10): ○ Immune deficiency ○ History of neoplasm ○ History of congenital heart disease ○ See Imaging in Known Genetic Conditions for additional indications ○ Coagulopathy ○ Occipital location ○ Age < 6 years

criteria.description: Patient age strictly less than 18 years
Persistent headache documented
At least one pediatric red flag condition present
Documented immune deficiency
Personal history of neoplasm
History of congenital heart disease
Coagulopathy present
Headache localized to occipital region
Patient age younger than 6 years

required_documentation: Pediatrician or pediatric neurologist clinical consultation note
Medical history validating presence of red flag feature

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR BONE MARROW MRI / Multiple Myeloma
source_quote: Initial Staging of Known Disease ○ Restaging on Active Treatment ○ Surveillance ■ Annually if asymptomatic

criteria.description: Confirmed diagnosis of multiple myeloma
Requested for initial staging, restaging on active therapy, or annual asymptomatic surveillance

required_documentation: Hematology/oncology consultation note documenting multiple myeloma staging, active chemotherapy/immunotherapy, or annual surveillance date
review_notes: Surveillance interval and staging indication for multiple myeloma bone marrow MRI.

review_notes: Urgent non-contrast CT for acute subarachnoid hemorrhage.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR BRAIN CT ANGIOGRAPHY / Aneurysm Screening
source_quote: For one first degree relative with aneurysm, asymptomatic screening is not indicated and would require a neurological sign or symptom supporting clinical concern for aneurysm

criteria.description: Patient has only one first-degree relative with intracranial aneurysm
Patient is entirely asymptomatic without focal neurological signs or symptoms

required_documentation: Neurological evaluation notes documenting active symptoms if CTA is requested with single affected relative
exclusion_conditions: Routine asymptomatic intracranial aneurysm screening in patients with only one affected first-degree relative
review_notes: Explicit policy exclusion requiring at least two first-degree relatives or neurological symptoms for aneurysm screening.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR BRAIN MRS (2) / Tumor Recurrence vs. Radiation Necrosis (3)

criteria.description: Known history of treated primary brain tumor or brain metastasis following radiation therapy
Equivocal enlarging or enhancing lesion on conventional MRI where tumor recurrence cannot be distinguished from radiation necrosis

required_documentation: Prior brain MRI report demonstrating indeterminate enhancing lesion and neuro-oncology / radiation oncology consultation notes
review_notes: Specialized MRS indication for differentiating recurrent glioma/metastasis from post-treatment radiation necrosis.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR BRAIN MR ANGIOGRAPHY / Aneurysm Screening
source_quote: Repeat study is recommended every 5-7 years

criteria.description: High-risk individual undergoing periodic surveillance for intracranial aneurysm (e.g. 2+ first-degree relatives)
Interval of at least 5 to 7 years elapsed since prior negative intracranial vascular screening

required_documentation: Family history verifying two or more first-degree relatives with intracranial aneurysm and prior negative MRA report
review_notes: 5-7 year periodic interval threshold for high-risk familial aneurysm surveillance.

criteria.description: Confirmed or clinically suspected primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL)

required_documentation: Neurology / oncology consultation notes and MRI findings consistent with suspected primary CNS lymphoma
review_notes: Oncology metabolic imaging indication for primary central nervous system lymphoma.

source_quote: Annual screening with Breast MRI for any ONE of the following:

criteria.description: Patient qualifies for annual high-risk breast cancer screening (e.g., BRCA mutation, lifetime risk > 20%, prior mantle radiation)

required_documentation: Genetic testing report documenting deleterious BRCA1/BRCA2 mutation or formal risk model calculation showing >= 20% lifetime risk
review_notes: High risk screening indication for breast MRI.

source_quote: MRI is not indicated for evaluation of saline implant complications

criteria.description: Imaging requested for evaluation of suspected saline breast implant complication or rupture

required_documentation: Documentation verifying implant composition (saline vs silicone)
exclusion_conditions: Breast MRI requested to evaluate suspected rupture or complications of saline implants
review_notes: Explicit non-covered policy exclusion barring MRI for saline implant deflation/rupture.

criteria.description: Acute ischemic stroke being evaluated for endovascular thrombectomy or reperfusion therapy

review_notes: 24-hour therapeutic window for cerebral CT perfusion penumbra evaluation.
